question: Which Indian Company was adjudged as the number 1 global solar power generation asset owner in terms of operating and off-taker contracted solar projects as per the latest ranking of global solar companies by Mercom Capital USA in September 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Adani Green Energy.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The latest ranking of global solar companies by **Mercom Capital **ranks the** Adani Group** as number one global solar power generation asset owner in terms of **operating solar projects.**
